Game Overview

Kunoichi Run is a action title where in Kunoichi Run, transform into a nimble ninja racing through challenging terrains. Dash, dodge, and fly with thrilling scrolls in this endless, high-speed adventure. Master timing and reflexes to outmaneuver obstacles and set new records in this adrenaline-pumping arcade experience.
